android_mechanism: Themed-font handling repeated expensive font work; fix performs the lookup/registration once
bug_description: MainPage.aboutToAppear unconditionally calls font.registerFont for two custom font families (iconfont.ttf and DINCOROS-Regular.ttf) every time the main page component is created. Each registration re-loads and re-parses the TTF files; navigating back to the main page (router.replaceUrl flows) repeats the work and delays page build, growing memory with duplicate typeface entries.
fix_summary: Font registration is guarded by a once-per-process static flag so the TTFs are loaded only on first creation.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

mechanism_oracle.definition: Time from MainPage creation (first build event in ace trace) to first frame rendered, averaged over recreations.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed shows TTF file reads + font registration work in the page-build path on every creation; fixed only on the first. unfixed_avg_build_ms > fixed_avg_build_ms (fixed approaches the no-font-work floor).

reproduction: git -C hosts/sepweather checkout case/sepweather_font_register_per_page/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/sepweather checkout case/sepweather_font_register_per_page/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
